description: Fidelity assessment for Pitch Factory journey cards against Arbios master layouts. All mappings are Pitch Factory implementation choices that preserve journey-stage structure; they are not claims that generated decks exactly reproduce the HTML master.

fidelity_levels.exact: Journey card content model fits the mapped master layout regions; Gamma template work is still required to render those regions.
fidelity_levels.approximate: Closest Arbios layout chosen to preserve journey-stage cards and slot provenance. Does not reproduce all master regions and is not an exact visual match.
fidelity_levels.duplicate_master_layout: Multiple journey cards intentionally map to the same Arbios layout id; template must differentiate cards.
fidelity_levels.unmapped_journey_card: Journey card has no Arbios fidelity entry.

mappings.template_action: Cover card must use F1 navy surface and white logo; not a generic title slide.
Implementation choice: closest L18 fit for one executive-summary body slot; plain text alone under-represents the master.
Implementation choice: matrix + notes structure preferred; single body block is insufficient for L08.
Implementation choice: table + bullet column preferred for scope content.
Implementation choice: L09 UI mock is the closest master layout; architecture prose alone will not match.
Implementation choice: certificate/commitment grid preferred; compliance body text is an approximate fit.
Implementation choice: phased step layout for timeline content.
Shares L16 with TIMELINE_01 by implementation choice; template needs differentiated cards.
Implementation choice: L23 management roster is closest to staffing/FTE content.
Implementation choice: big-number + bars preferred; metrics prose alone under-represents L11.
Implementation choice: journey final card mapped to F3 closing; template must apply closing treatment.

master_layouts_not_in_journey.label: Who we are
master_layouts_not_in_journey.notes: Fixed company data slide; not part of First Contact / Deepening / Concretisation card lists.

master_layouts_not_in_journey.label: Section divider
master_layouts_not_in_journey.notes: Used in use-case portfolio deck (see use_case_presentation_reference.json), not pitch journey stages.

gamma_template_requirements: Each journey layout_id needs a distinct Gamma template card with regions matching the mapped Arbios layout fidelity notes.
Theme supplies CI (colour, typography, logo, footer); it does not select L01–L24 structures.
POST /generations/from-template preserves template card structure; per-card Arbios layout selection requires template rebuild in Gamma dashboard.
Arbios layout metadata stays in contracts, SlideSpec layoutId, and compliance modules — never in Gamma inputText.
